student_learning_goal: I can compare areas of shapes by matching or covering.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can compare areas of shapes by matching or covering.
header.character_watermark: Roo the Ruler Rabbit in the top-right with square tiles and a ruler. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Count tiles inside 4 shapes. Write the count.
parts.visual_layout: Four shapes pre-tiled with square tiles plus an answer line for each tile count.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 tile-count layout for area worksheet, B&W line art. 4 pre-tiled shapes: rectangle (3x2=6 tiles), L-shape (5 tiles), square (4x4=16 tiles), staircase (10 tiles). Each with answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P1_COUNT at Part 1: keywords name the tiles inside shapes count task.

parts.student_instructions: For 2 shape pairs, circle BIGGER, SMALLER, or SAME area.
parts.visual_layout: Two pairs of shapes side by side with comparison choice circles for each pair.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 area comparison layout for area worksheet, B&W line art. 2 shape pairs side by side. Pair 1: 3x2 rectangle vs 2x4 rectangle. Pair 2: square vs L-shape (same total area). Below each: BIGGER / SMALLER / SAME circles.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P2_COMP at Part 2: keywords name the pairs of shapes for comparison.

parts.answer_key: Pair 1: 8 vs 6, so left smaller, right bigger. Pair 2: SAME (both 4 tiles).

parts.student_instructions: Draw 2 DIFFERENT shapes that have the SAME area (each 6 tiles).
parts.visual_layout: Two empty grid workspaces side by side for drawing the matching shapes.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 same-area workspace for area worksheet, B&W line art. 2 empty grid workspaces side by side, each ~6cm x 4cm. Note: 'Both shapes have area = 6 tiles'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P3_SAME at Part 3: keywords name the workspace pair for drawing same-area shapes.

parts.answer_key: Any 2 different shapes with 6 tiles (e.g., rectangle 6x1 and L-shape 6 squares).

early_finisher_prompt: Find the area of a NEW rectangle (5 cm × 3 cm). Show your row × column working.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Formative — check careful tile counting.
